li (acct exec): Heads-up: SafePay wants a 2-week eval to move off CompetitorQ. Key asks: webhook signature parity, deterministic function-calls (JSON schema), token billing delta, and EU-only processing. Can we scope?
owen (solutions): Yep. Do they rely on streaming chat or synchronous function calls for authorization?
li (acct exec): Both. Chat for UX, sync function-calls for settlement. Peak traffic ~200rps for auth path.
tara (engineer): Note: CompetitorQ streams small deltas and reorders chunk boundaries. Our stream is coalesced which can change client reconnection heuristics. We'll propose a tiny proxy shim to normalize chunks.
ben (security): SafePay needs KMS integration, SOC2 attestation, and wants audit logs forwarded to their Splunk. Also EU residency + DPA. I'll need their security contact and CompetitorQ's answers if possible.
owen (solutions): Ask them to send 10 representative function-call payloads + webhook examples (sanitized). We'll run side-by-side diffs: schema pass %, token delta per prompt, and 5 example diffs showing divergence.
li (acct exec): I'll request artifacts and their legal/security contacts tonight.
tara (engineer): Quick smoke snippet we can give them to run locally: 
```
# parity smoke to our compat endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compat/generate \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compat-q","input":"<<sanitized payload>>","max_tokens":180,"stream":false}'
```
Run same payload against CompetitorQ and paste outputs. We'll diff with `jq` + simple tokenized diff.
owen (solutions): For billing we'll prepare: hosted per-token estimate, Dedicated reserved pool pricing, and a 2-week POC credit. Recommend 35% credit to cover integration and test volume.
ben (security): Potential blocker: SafePay requires HSM-backed keys and mutual TLS for webhook endpoints. Confirm Dedicated + KMS bridge supports HSM wrapping with their provider. Also need their DPO for DPIA scope.
tara (engineer): Another potential mismatch: CompetitorQ's tokenizer treats some unicode punctuation as two tokens; we'll include a token-estimator script and example token delta table for their 10 prompts. If sampling params cause variance, map temp->0 and top_p->1 for deterministic calls.
li (acct exec): Good. Any infra lead time if they want a Dedicated EU instance for the POC?
owen (solutions): Provisioning Dedicated in eu-west-1 typically 4 business days. If they want a temporary pool faster we can spin a small reserved test cluster but need infra approval.
ndabot: NDA template and SOC2 link available: https://contracts.redwood.ai/nda ; https://security.redwood.ai/soc2.pdf. Provide legal contact and I can issue one-way NDA <24h.
ben (security): Also request egress allowlist/denylist requirements and whether they need IP-based egress restrictions to certain ASNs. Add me once NDA signed.
tara (engineer): We'll prepare a small rewrap shim (node/python) to: 1) accept CompetitorQ-style webhook sig header, 2) verify, 3) re-sign with X-RWD-SIG for their verifier, and optionally normalize streaming chunks into CompetitorQ-style fragments.
owen (solutions): Blockers checklist: sanitized payload + webhook schema, legal/security contacts, KMS/HSM details, and peak traffic profile. ETA: if artifacts arrive by tomorrow noon, we can ship a POC bundle (config, token-delta, shim, pricing) in 3 business days. Dedicated adds ~4 days.
li (acct exec): I'll get artifacts today. Ben/Owen/Tara: can you support the 2-week timeline if we get everything tomorrow?
ben (security): Yes, will review questionnaire and join calls.
tara (engineer): Yes, can build shim and run parities.
owen (solutions): Yes, will run side-by-side and produce a short executive summary: key deltas, estimated monthly delta, and recommended mitigations.
li (acct exec): Great 601e I'll update SafePay: 1) we can do the POC, 2) need sanitized payloads + contacts, 3) expect POC pack in 3 business days after artifacts, 4) Dedicated EU lead time ~4 days, 5) recommend 35% POC credit.
owen (solutions): Also suggest we include an integration checklist for their engineers (headers to accept, reconnect/heartbeat, token-estimator script). Saves time.
li (acct exec): Perfect. Thanks team :raised_hands:
